node.statement: Fix universal constants K_def,e_def witnessing the O(delta+epsilon) compression-to-raw-product bounds in def-compressed-corner, and the constants and thresholds in the five named externals. After shrinking a universal e_nest, every t-projection used below, at every amplification, has uniformly bounded norm; moreover P^R=Co^A_R(P) and Q^R=Co^A_R(Q) differ from P,Q by O(t), with universal dimension-free coefficients.
